references.text: Nethanel son of Zuar is mentioned again as the leader of the tribe of Issachar when the camp arrangement is described.
Nethanel son of Zuar brings his offering as the leader of the tribe of Issachar at the dedication of the tabernacle.
Nethanel leads the army of the tribe of Issachar when the Israelites break camp from Sinai.
Issachar was the fifth son of Jacob and Leah, and became the ancestor of the tribe of Issachar.
Jacob's blessing over Issachar, which describes the character and future of the tribe.
